name: mcp-sam-gov
description: Keyless-first: 152 tools for US federal + state/local (SLED) government contracting, spending, regulation & partner vetting. Independent project — not affiliated with or endorsed by SAM.gov or the U.S. GSA.
long_description: One-click Claude Desktop extension for US-government business intelligence — 152 tools, 147 of them with no API key. Search federal AND state/local (SLED) solicitations (SAM.gov, Grants.gov, OpenGov, Bonfire); analyze spending and awards (USAspending, FPDS); vet a partner across sanctions, exclusions, single-audit findings, bank health, and environmental compliance (OFAC, SAM, FAC, FDIC, EPA); check product recalls (openFDA, NHTSA, CPSC); pull litigation (CourtListener); and read regulation (Federal Register, eCFR, FAR/DFARS, NIST 800-53). Anti-hallucination autocomplete keeps NAICS/agency/recipient answers grounded. Honesty-hardened: totals are never a page length, outages throw instead of returning empty, and a missing value is null (never a fabricated $0). Keyless-first: 5 tools need a free key (Census business-patterns, FRED, BEA and DOL's data endpoint); other optional free keys (SAM.gov, api.data.gov, BLS and more) only raise rate limits. Independent open-source project — not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by SAM.gov, the U.S. General Services Administration (GSA), or any other government agency; it reads publicly available government open-data APIs.

sam_gov_api_key.title: SAM.gov API key (optional)
sam_gov_api_key.description: Leave blank for keyless mode. Set only for higher SAM.gov rate limits or archives older than 12 months.

census_api_key.title: Census API key (required for Census business-patterns)
census_api_key.description: Needed only for census_business_patterns: the Census Data API has no keyless tier, so that tool returns an error without it. Every other tool works without this key.

fred_api_key.title: FRED API key (required for the FRED tools)
fred_api_key.description: Needed only for fred_search_series and fred_series_observations: FRED has no keyless tier. Every other tool works without this key.

bea_api_key.title: BEA API key (required for BEA regional data)
bea_api_key.description: Needed only for bea_regional_data: the BEA Data API has no keyless tier. Every other tool works without this key.

dol_api_key.title: DOL API key (required for DOL data)
dol_api_key.description: Needed only for dol_get_dataset: DOL's data endpoint has no keyless tier (dol_list_datasets works without it). Every other tool works without this key.

data_gov_api_key.title: api.data.gov key (optional)
data_gov_api_key.description: Optional free key; raises the shared DEMO_KEY limits for Regulations.gov, Congress.gov, GovInfo, FAC, the data.gov catalog and GSA per-diem.
